context: The party is poking around an abandoned chapel of Selûne where they recently passed a few bandits arguing outside and worried about someone still inside. Inside the chapel they find skeletons dressed like scribes, but each is armed and there are no clear signs of a struggle — an odd detail that suggests they either died standing their ground or were prepared for violence. This fits a broader pattern the party may have already noticed: individual armored skeletons and piles of dead in justiciar cuirasses around town, which some companions (like Shadowheart) might have special insight into. Other nearby encounters—rotting corpses in cellars and recent captures/killing of cultists—mean violent death has been showing up in several places lately, so these bodies could be part of a wider, unexplained tide of conflict.
